blocks.text: The 2026-27 NBA season continued Sunday, November 17 (November 16 in the US) with the Miami Heat, Orlando Magic, Philadelphia 76ers and Minnesota Timberwolves headlining the winners. Miami Heat beat Houston Rockets, 128-110 Giannis Antetokounmpo led Miami with 20 points, 13 rebounds and six assists, while Andrew Wiggins and Klay Thompson scored 17 points apiece. Davion Mitchell recorded 16 points and 10 assists, and Bobby Portis Jr. added 16 points for the Heat.
